# ghost/buddha-quotes

Read and advance offline Buddha Quotes without likes, lists, sharing or timers

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/buddha-quotes
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/buddha-quotes open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/buddha-quotes read_quote --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/buddha-quotes next_quote --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the offline Buddha Quotes reader
- `read_quote`: Read the exposed quote text without liking or saving
- `next_quote`: Advance once with the native Next control and read the new quote
